family: BIGTREETECH Octopus V1.1 controller (eight driver sockets, STM32F446ZET6)
vendor: Shenzhen Big Tree Technology Co., Ltd.
source_level: vendor manual (text PDF), vendor pin-out drawing (image, read by eye), Klipper's example configuration for the board
title: BIGTREETECH Octopus V1.0 user manual (EN, updated 2021-07-19), 'BIGTREETECH Octopus - PIN.jpg' (revision date 2026-02-01), 'BIGTREETECH Octopus - SIZE.pdf'
version_note: Hardware/readme.txt in the vendor repository: 'The schematic diagrams of V1.0 & V1.1 are the same. Compared with V1.0, V1.1 only fixes the wrong silk screen (fan, spi3, uart2) on the motherboard and has changed the packaging of the power supply IC'. The manual is written for V1.0

mcu.source: manual 1.2 item 3 (some boards carry an STM32F429: Klipper cfg header)

hole_pattern_mm.source: manual 1.2 item 2: 'Mounting hole to hole size: 150*90mm'; hole diameter not transcribed

input_v.source: manual 1.1 item 6: 12 V or 24 V (12 V only on motor and bed; logic input must be > 14.1 V); 1.2 item 4: recommended DC24V

power_inputs.source: manual 2.1 and PIN drawing: three separate inputs with common grounds

rails.source: manual 1.1 item 6 and 2.1: '12V rail can supply up to 4A, the 5V up to 8A and the 3.3V up to 1A' (not recommended to load them to the maximum)

bed.source: manual 8 item 3: 'The motherboard can power heated beds up to 300W' (12.5 A at 24 V, DERIVED)

heaters.source: manual 1.1 item 4; current per output not in the manual's text

fans.source: manual 1.1 item 7 (voltage per fan selectable Vin / 12 V / 5 V; flyback protection); current per port not in the manual's text

driver_sockets.note: nine outputs on eight drivers: MOTOR2_1 and MOTOR2_2 are in parallel on driver 2

endstops.note: the DIAG0..DIAG7 headers (5 V, GND, signal); each driver's DIAG reaches its pin through a jumper (manual 4)
endstops.source: PIN drawing; Klipper cfg (endstop_pin PG6 / PG9 / PG10, filament switches PG12-PG15)

probe_port.note: 'SENSOR' header (VS, GND, PB7): optocoupler-isolated, no BAT85 needed; NPN probes need an external 4k7 pull-up; enable the pin's internal pull-down (manual 2.7)

motor_pins.source: PIN drawing (EN / STEP / DIR / CS rows) and Klipper cfg (Driver0..Driver7, tmc2209 uart_pin); DIAG n = STOP n

fuses.value: replaceable blade fuses on the inputs (manual 1.1 item 14); ratings not transcribed

price_usd.status: not fetched (vendor shop not reachable from this session); the catalogue's 55 USD is typical, unverified
